title: Normal-form width bounded by decision-tree depth
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$, and let $G$ be an AND or OR gate. Then $f$ has a representation of width at most the decision-tree depth of the function on binary inputs obtained by converting each binary coordinate to its corresponding sign.
